cck-brand__text: text column wrapper inside styled .cck-brand flex row (NC .app-info context; icon sibling is flex-shrink:0)
cck-crm: CRM-link fieldset marker; JS binds via data-cck-crm attributes; fieldset chrome via styled .cck-refpick-field
cck-nav-link: JS hook (carecheck-main.js active-state toggle + aria-current) co-emitted on styled .cck-nav__link
cck-nav__item: structural li inside styled .cck-nav__list; anchors styled via .cck-nav__link
cck-nav__subitem: structural li inside styled .cck-nav__sublist; anchors styled via .cck-nav__sublink
cck-refpick--multi: multi-select modifier read via classList by buildRefPick on styled .cck-refpick
cck-section: config-transfer pack section marker; card chrome + section rhythm via .cck-card
cck-skip-link--nav: nav-target modifier on styled .cck-skip-link (distinguishes the second skip link)
cck-table-actions: shared-pack topology co-emitted on styled .cck-license-table-actions (synced license-page template, ds-owned)
cck-transfer-report: import-report dialog marker on styled .cck-dialog (transfer.js fills rows by id)
cck-view-head__text: middle grid item; track already clamped by minmax(0,1fr) in styled .cck-view-head
